d: A 25-year-old man in China is drawing attention online for an unusual aquarium act. Xiao Songyi performs as a male mermaid at an aquarium in Wuhan, Hubei province, swimming inside a giant tank in a mermaid tail. A former professional diver, Songyi turned to underwater performances after an injury cut short his sporting career. His routines include spins, dives, underwater sword dances and even playing the flute. He can perform up to ten shows over a weekend.
